drivingQuestion: If unspecified dedications go to Temple maintenance, what does Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira derive from כשדה החרם לכהן תהיה אחזתו?
outcomeNote: The question is left standing at the close of this unit; it is answered at the opening of the next (arakhin.sugya205).

segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן בְּתִירָא אוֹמֵר: סְתַם חֲרָמִים לְבֶדֶק הַבַּיִת כּוּ׳. בִּשְׁלָמָא רַבָּנַן כִּדְקָא מְפָרְשִׁי טַעְמַיְיהוּ וְטַעְמָא דְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן בְּתִירָא, אֶלָּא רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן בְּתִירָא הַאי ״כִּשְׂדֵה הַחֵרֶם״ מַאי עָבֵיד לֵיהּ?
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira says dedications» donated «without specification» are designated «for Temple maintenance,» as it is stated: “Every dedicated item is most sacred to the Lord” (Leviticus 27:28). And the Rabbis say they are designated for priests, as it is stated: “As a field dedicated; its possession shall be to the priest” (Leviticus 27:21), whereas the verse cited by Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira teaches that dedication takes effect on offerings of the most sacred order and offerings of lesser sanctity. The Gemara asks: «Granted,» the opinion of «the Rabbis» is clear, «as they explain their reason and the reason of Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira,» i.e., they interpret the verse he cited as his proof. «But» as for «Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira, this» verse: «“As a field dedicated;» its possession shall be to the priest,” «what does he do with it,» i.e., what does he derive from it?
